title: Lower semicontinuity on open sets under vague convergence (portmanteau P1)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ and U ⊆ ℝ^N. Let μ_i (i ∈ ℕ) and μ be measures on ℝ^N such that μ_i(K) < ∞ for every i and every compact K ⊆ U, and μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U. Suppose ∫ g dμ_i → ∫ g dμ (Bochner integrals) for every continuous compactly supported g : ℝ^N → ℝ with tsupport g ⊆ U. Then μ(O) ≤ liminf_i μ_i(O) for every open O ⊆ U.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclidean N)) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)), (∀ (i : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclidean N)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μs i K ≠ ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K ≠ ∞) → (∀ g : Euclidean N → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫ x, g x ∂(μs i)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, g x ∂μ))) → ∀ O : Set (Euclidean N), IsOpen O → O ⊆ U → μ O ≤ liminf (fun i ↦ μs i O) atTop
